name: Investigation Reason 2
definition: Provides the details reason for the investigation request.

Sequence.name: Sequence
Sequence.definition: Where the InvestigationData block is repeated this identifies a numeric reference for the Reason that can be used for reconciliation of data.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Reason for the investigation being opened.

ReasonSubType.name: Reason Sub Type
ReasonSubType.definition: Sub type which further identifies the reason for an investigation being opened.

AdditionalRequestData.name: Additional Request Data
AdditionalRequestData.definition: Additional information relating to the request.

RelatedInvestigationData.name: Related Investigation Data
RelatedInvestigationData.definition: Additional information related to the request that will be sent or made available seperately, such as a copy of a passport.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document enclosed in the message.||Usage: The use of the EnclosedFile element must be bilaterally agreed.

RelatedFileData.name: Related File Data
RelatedFileData.definition: Details of a document not enclosed in the message that will be sent or made available seperately.

InvestigationReasonAndAdditionalRequestD.definition: If Reason/Code is Narrative (NARR), then AdditionalRequestData must be present.
